Human Antispoof PoC model

Runtime: @vladmandic/human 3.3.6 (already pinned in package-lock.json)
Model: Human Anti-Spoofing / Real-of-Fake, 128x128 RGB input, single score output
Model source: https://github.com/vladmandic/human-models
Pinned source revision: bc66dc53bac03c96d35a7e6daaf717e72f3985f5
Revision date: 2023-06-12
Model source license: MIT (LICENSE in this directory)
Upstream model credit: https://www.kaggle.com/anku420/fake-face-detection

SHA-256:
  antispoof.bin  4490fecb2becdb6869edc7e60f5e59962be013a8def8719b1373afb0f905c094
  antispoof.json 7fd698ae1cebabbcad79d3b8b448587b0365eb7911987418231bdcf36583112a

The Human model documentation lists the model and credits the Kaggle
"Real-of-Fake" model. The repository MIT license is included with the weights.
The original Kaggle artifact's independent license, training-data provenance,
calibration, and attack-subtype performance could not be independently
confirmed. Treat this as a local, informational proof of concept only; obtain
rights confirmation and independently validate the model before any deployment.

The application uses a 0.50 score threshold only as a demo cutoff. This is not a
calibrated or validated security threshold. Inference runs in the kiosk browser;
frames and model scores are not uploaded or persisted. A model load or output
failure is a failed check, never a successful check.

Human Facemesh (alignment) model
Runtime/source: files copied unmodified from the official npm package @vladmandic/human 3.3.6
(node_modules/@vladmandic/human/models/). License: MIT (LICENSE in this directory).
SHA-256:
  facemesh.bin  3826da640b0a3021161605369ee6af293f75d518040355b960ec71a3390c1c0b
  facemesh.json b60ca26f404724f43bd2b1575761d8265180e1f053cc0731caa68462927309e7
The same package copy has byte-identical blazeface.bin and faceres.bin to the vendored ones.
Used only for an optional, informational alignment measurement; not an identity decision.
